[2026-11-18] Released data/manip_ground and data/manip_table: whole-body manipulation of 517 objects (1,273 physics-validated motions). Their 4D HOI reconstructions use the SOMA body model instead of SMPL-X; see the format notes below.
[2026-11-10] Added data/stair_p3 and data/stair_p4: 12,512 new stair motions (ascending and descending) on 2,000 new procedurally generated stair assets, with sequence lengths from 5 s to 12 s.
